profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at The Farmer's Dog
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with focus on Back-End development managing APIs written in Go, Node.js and GraphQL. Interests in working with high traffic systems, increasing performance, and reducing tech debt. Strong engineering professional with a B.S focused in Computer Science from New Jersey Institute of Technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies used:
- Node.js, GraphQL, Golang (Go)
- AWS Lambda, SNS Notifications
- MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis (caching)

positions.title: Senior Applications Developer
positions.description:
Technologies used:
- Node.js, Express, Alexa Voice Assistants, AWS Lambda
- MongoDB, Elasticsearch
- Openshift, Docker, Jenkins

positions.title: Senior Technology Development Program Associate
positions.description:
Technologies used:
- JavaScript, Node.js, ReactJS, MeteorJS
- MongoDB, MySQL, LDAP

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Civic Engagement Computer Center (CECC)
• Developed a video based training management system for agencies to learn how to use Drupal and Wordpress
• Processed requirements and use cases to create ER diagrams to then create tables within a MySQL database on the production server
• Added multiple user types and site admin login to manage, create, edit, and delete users, courses, agencies, and permissions

positions.title: TDP Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a program using Python to convert XML to JSON in order to push into Elastic Search indices
• Created Big Data reporting visualizations with the use of Kibana and Elastic Search
• Produced Visio work flows that show the relational mappings between parent child work objects
• Reviewed PL/SQL procedures of certain tables in order to create new code for data archiving
• Analyzed documentation of a Pega Application in order to remodel Provider update service parameters
• Wrote python scripts to automate the filtering of current vs incoming data models

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed on the front end of a web application project in digital health
• Excelled in rapid product development within an agile environment 
• Worked on bug fixes, new features, updates, and styling improvements using HTML, CSS, and AngularJs
• Created unit and protractor tests for form validity of over 20 partials
• Participated and contributed to a 4 day Babson Technical Excellence proof of concept application
• Developed a web-based hybrid iPhone app using newly introduced framework: AppGyver and Supersonic

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
• Created and simplified an organized structure of viewing various projects, milestones, and deadlines
• Conducted follow ups with project leads of over 60 projects based on assigned tasks and milestones 
• Reduced and closed numerous amounts of tickets that have reached over 30 days and became overdue

positions.title: Service Clerk
positions.description:
• Provided exceptional customer service and handled transactions from customers at register
• Organized stock room and ensured merchandise was stored properly
• Stocked shelves and conducted inventory to increase sales

positions.title: Front Desk Receptionist
positions.description:
• Maintained an occupancy level above 85%
• Provided frontline customer service behind front desk and assisted guests’ with their concerns
• Balanced cash drops and night audits
• Answered phone calls and made reservations using ‘Choice Hotels’ online booking system
